拿着袋子和鱼进入厨房，杀鱼清洗，看着油罐里那一点点的油，红烧就别想了，清炖吧！烧火开锅，手脚麻利地把两条鱼全炖上了，还好锅大。

避开老爷子的视线，伸进自己带的袋子里，从空间里拿出半盆棒子面，围着锅边贴了一圈饼子。老爷子站在厨房门口看着重孙子做饭，心疼得嘴角直抽抽。这也就是王野，要是换个人这么做饭，腿都得给他打断。

就在王野做饭时，王野的爷爷奶奶、二叔三叔也准备下工回家了。

“娘，咱家烟筒咋冒烟了，爷爷不会给咱们做饭呢吧？”大叔挑着扁担，转头问着身旁的老妇人。“快，快点，可别把老爷子累着。”边说边急忙往家走。

开门进院子，看见老爷子在厨房门口，倚着门框抽着烟锅。

爷爷问：“爹，你咋还做上饭了？”

老爷子瞥了一眼王爷爷：“美得你冒大鼻涕泡，还给你做饭，是我宝贝重孙孙来了，他在做饭。”

爷爷满脸惊喜：“我大孙子来了？”

爷爷奶奶赶紧快走两步向厨房走来。王野听见动静，也出门迎了上去，打招呼道：“爷爷奶奶，二叔二婶，三叔三婶。”

奶奶挤开众人，上前拉住王野的手，带着哭腔说：“诶呦喂，我的大孙子呦！你可算回来了呀！奶奶想死你了，我大孙子大了，也高了。”

边说边抹眼泪。这真是时间长不回来了，看把奶奶给激动的。

“奶奶，我毕业了，以后会经常回来的。”

奶奶高兴地说：“好啊好啊，可不能学你那个缺德的爹！进了城就忘了娘，这都多久不回来了，最气人的是，自己去就去呗！还把我大孙带走。”

王野心想：“老爹，你就感谢我吧！我这时候要是嘴一歪歪，你就等着爷爷奶奶的混合双打吧！”

王野赶紧说：“爷爷奶奶，你们也进屋吧，饭熟了，咱先吃饭。”

奶奶欣慰地点头：“好好，大孙儿真是长大了，都能做饭了。”

一家人进入屋子，二叔三叔两家却没有进屋，二叔说道：“爷爷，爹娘，我们就先回家了。”

王野急忙拦着他们：“二叔三叔，别走别走，我做的饭多，够吃的。”

二叔三叔从结婚后就自己家开火了，一般农村都这样，一个是减少矛盾，尤其是兄弟多的，甚至有很多人家还专门组织人见证分家。

二叔三叔犹豫着看向爷爷奶奶。爷爷刚要说话，太爷爷面色微怒地说：“怎么，我重孙孙说话不好使吗？”

太爷爷是从旧社会过来的，对于长房嫡传这些观念相当看重。王野可是长房长子长孙长重孙，这一摞bUff叠起来，太狠了。在老太爷眼里，王野那是整个王家的未来。

见老爷子发话了，二叔三叔也就应声答应。他们可不敢忤逆太爷的意思。这要是把太爷气出个好歹来，王家沟也就没他们的立足之地了。因为太爷是他这一辈儿唯一一位幸存的老祖宗了。

二婶三婶招呼后面探头探脑的一帮小屁孩儿。二叔家大女儿王兰，儿子王卫国，三叔家大儿子王建国，小儿子王建军。

王野对着妹妹说：“呦，咱家小兰也是大丫头了，咋地不认识大哥了？”

王兰怯生生地叫了一声：“大哥”。

王野调笑道：“这丫头，还害羞了，忘了小时候跟在我屁股后面满村子乱跑了。”

王兰更害羞了，低着头玩弄衣角。

王野见状，也不调侃了：“先进屋，进来大哥给你们好吃的。”

Take the bag and the fish into the kitchen, kill the fish and clean it. Looking at the little bit of oil in the oil tank, don’t think about braising it in braised sauce, just stew it!He turned on the fire and stewed the two fishes quickly. Fortunately, the pot was big.

Avoiding the old man's sight, he reached into the bag he brought, took out half a pot of stick noodles from the space, and placed a circle of pancakes around the edge of the pot.The old man stood at the door of the kitchen and watched his great-grandson cooking, his mouth twitching with distress.This is Wang Ye. If anyone else cooks like this, his legs will be broken.

While Wang Ye was cooking, Wang Ye's grandparents, second uncle and third uncle were also preparing to go home from work.

"Mom, why is our chimney smoking? Grandpa won't cook for us, right?" The uncle picked up the pole and turned to ask the old woman beside him."Hurry, hurry up, don't tire the old man." He said as he hurried home.

Opening the door and entering the yard, I saw the old man at the door of the kitchen, leaning on the door frame and smoking a pot.

Grandpa asked: "Dad, why are you still cooking?"

The old man glanced at Grandpa Wang and said, "It's so beautiful that you have a lot of snot in your nose and even cooks for you. It's my precious great-grandson here and he's cooking."

Grandpa's face was full of surprise: "My eldest grandson is here?"

Grandpa and grandma hurriedly took two steps towards the kitchen.Wang Ye heard the noise and went out to greet them, saying hello: "Grandpa and grandma, second uncle and second aunt, third uncle and three aunt."

Grandma pushed through the crowd, stepped forward, took Wang Ye's hand, and said in a tearful tone: "Hey, my eldest grandson! You are back! Grandma misses you so much. My eldest grandson is older and taller."

As he spoke, he wiped away tears.This is really a long time coming, it makes grandma so excited.

"Grandma, I have graduated and will come back often in the future."

Grandma said happily: "Okay, okay, but I can't imitate your wicked father! When you enter the city, you forget about your mother. She won't come back for a long time. The most annoying thing is that you can just go by yourself! And you even take my grandson away."

Wang Ye thought: "Dad, just thank me! If I make a mistake at this moment, just wait for my grandparents' mixed doubles!"

Wang Ye quickly said: "Grandpa and grandma, you can come into the house too. The food is ready. Let's eat first."

Grandma nodded happily: "Okay, my eldest grandson has grown up and can cook."

The family entered the house, but the second uncle and the third uncle did not enter the house. The second uncle said: "Grandpa, parents, let's go home first."

Wang Ye hurriedly stopped them: "Second uncle and third uncle, don't leave, don't leave. I've cooked a lot of food, enough to eat."

After the second uncle and the third uncle got married, their families started to live in harmony. This is generally the case in rural areas. One is to reduce conflicts, especially if there are many brothers. Many families even organize people to witness the separation of the family.

The second and third uncles looked at their grandparents hesitantly.Just as the grandfather was about to speak, the great-grandfather said with a slightly angry expression: "What, isn't it difficult for my great-grandson to speak?"

Grandpa comes from the old society and attaches great importance to the concept of direct inheritance from the eldest son.Wang Ye is the eldest son, eldest grandson, and great-grandson of the eldest son. This stack of bUffs is too cruel.In the eyes of the old man, Wang Ye is the future of the entire Wang family.

Seeing that the old man had spoken, the second uncle and the third uncle agreed.They didn't dare to disobey the master's wishes.If this makes the master angry, there will be no place for them in Wangjiagou.Because my grandfather is the only surviving ancestor in his generation.

The second aunt and the third aunt greeted a group of little kids who were poking their heads behind them.The eldest daughter of the second uncle's family is Wang Lan and his son Wang Weiguo. The eldest son of the third uncle's family is Wang Jianguo and the youngest son Wang Jianjun.

Wang Ye said to his sister: "Hey, our Xiaolan is also a eldest girl. Why don't you recognize your eldest brother?"

Wang Lan timidly called out: "Brother."

Wang Ye joked: "This girl is so shy that she forgot that she followed me around the village when she was little."

Wang Lan became even more shy, lowering her head and playing with the hem of her clothes.

When Wang Ye saw this, he stopped teasing: "Go into the room first, come in and big brother will give you something delicious."
